Number of studies.evidence_source: The section discusses general findings and refers to other studies (Kéri, 2011; Sternberg & Lubart, 1996; Sternberg & O'Hara, 1999; Eysenck, 1995; Simonton, 1999; Batey et al., 2010), but it does not present a new study or experiment within this section.

section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the significant role of intelligence in creative achievement, asserting that successful creators are both creative and intelligent. It highlights that intelligence and creative activities contribute additively to creative achievement, with their interaction explaining additional variance. The text also notes that creative activities mediate the influence of openness and creative potential on creative achievement, forming a moderated mediation model, and that intelligence is particularly relevant to creative achievement rather than predicting the exertion of creative activities.
